newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-JUVENTUS SAY DEL PIERO, VIERI NOT FOR SALE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUVENTUS SAY DEL PIERO, VIERI NOT FOR SALE.

text.p: European champions Juventus said on Wednesday strikers Alessandro Del Piero and Christian Vieri will not go on the transfer market at the end of this season.
The club confirmed remarks by Luciano Moggi, general manager of the Italian Serie A league leaders in Tuttosport daily.
"Vieri and Del Piero are untouchable," Moggi was quoted as saying. "I repeat, Vieri and Del Piero aren't to be let go and are not to be negotiaited over. That's official."

The Turin club's vice-president Roberto Bettega sparked rumour earlier this month when he said every player had his price after Spanish club Atletico Madrid reportedly made an offer of 25 billion lire ($15 million) for 23-year-old Vieri.
Several English clubs are rumoured to be interested in Del Piero, 22, who has been out since February with a thigh strain.

Car tycoon Giovanni Agnelli, whose family own Juventus, implied Del Piero might be for sale during last weekend's match against Parma when he said it was never a disaster to lose a player but it depended on who replaced him.

Moggi said earlier this month that Juventus would not go down the same road as last year when they sold striker Fabrizio Ravanelli for $11 million to English side Middlesbrough and Portuguese midfielder Paulo Sousa to German champions Borussia Dortmund.
Juventus need only one point, and maybe not even that, to clinch the Italian league title this season and face Borussia Dortmund in Munich on May 28 in the final of the European Cup.
